title: Luxuriant Juicy Saudi Arabian Lamb Kebabs
description: A delicious and earthy Saudi Arabian dish featuring lamb, butter, and dates, perfect for a romantic date night, this recipe is also FODMAP friendly and cooked in a stone bowl dolsot.
instructions: Preheat the stone bowl dolsot over medium-high heat.
Thread the lamb cubes onto skewers, leaving a small space between each piece.
Brush the melted butter onto the lamb, then sprinkle with salt, black pepper, cumin, and coriander.
Add the garlic-infused oil to the preheated stone bowl dolsot and swirl it around.
Add the lamb skewers to the stone bowl dolsot and cook for 5 minutes per side, or until cooked to an internal temperature of 145 degrees.
While the lamb is cooking, heat the dates in a small saucepan over low heat.
Once the lamb is cooked, serve it with the heated dates and any accumulated juices from the stone bowl dolsot.
Garnish with fresh parsley or cilantro, if desired.
